keyVerseDR: "...they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us." (Mt 1:23)

level1.title: God With Us
level1.story: An angel came to Joseph in a dream. He said, "Take Mary as your wife. Her Baby is from God!" Joseph obeyed.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who talked to Joseph in a dream?
How can you listen to God?
level1.prayer: Jesus, You are always with me. Amen.

activity.title: What did they say?
activity.intro: Write or draw what each one said.

level2.title: Joseph's Yes
level2.story: Mary was engaged to Joseph, and she was going to have a baby by the Holy Spirit. Joseph was a good man and did not want to shame her. An angel came to him in a dream and said, "Do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife." The angel said to name the baby Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins. Joseph woke up and did what the angel told him.
level2.keyLine: They shall call his name Emmanuel, God with us.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Where do you need God to be 'with you'?
level2.prayer: St. Joseph, help me trust God like you. Amen.

activity.title: Joseph, I wonder...
activity.intro: Joseph trusted God's plan. Write what you wonder.
starters: Jesus, I wonder how Joseph felt...
Jesus, I wonder why You are called...
Help me trust You like Joseph...

art.mainBrief: Joseph asleep, gentle angel above; Mary in the background
art.heartBrief: Joseph's carpentry tools around heart; 'yes' banner
